thread:
deploy-bot: Beginning canary rollout v2.10.3 -> ap-south (change window 03/22 22:00-00:00 UTC). Plan: 8% -> 30% -> 80%. Dash: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/ijkl
jordan: quick check: embeddings route p99 latency up ~1s on canary, error rate creeping to 0.7% on /v1/embeddings :grimacing:
emma: getting 502s with upstream grpc: deadline exceeded in embed-worker logs
siva: our SLO guard is 0.5% 5xx sustained over 10m for pause. Recommend hold at 8% and dig in
deploy-bot: Pausing rollout at 8% per @siva. Canary hold engaged and notifications sent
infra-bot: auto-runbook triggered: snapshotting pod metrics, restart back-off check, and collecting heap profiles from embed-worker
jordan: repro attempt with canary header returns 502 consistently. Trace shows blobstore timeouts when fetching cache shards
emma: blobstore had a transient GC pause earlier in that region; ops increased async workers which might cause more concurrent requests to blobstore
siva: mitigation: throttle blobstore client concurrency on canary via feature-flag, and increase embed-worker replicas from 3->6 briefly. Apply and observe
deploy-bot: Applying canary flag: blobstore.max_concurrency=16 and scaling embed-worker to 6 in ap-south. Monitoring SLOs
emma: after changes 5xx dropped to 0.15% in 5m and p99 latency back to baseline within 4m
jordan: good signal. Keep at 8% for 20m and run synthetic trace samples. If stable, advance to 30%
oncall-bot: Notifying eng-storage and eng-runtime. Current oncall: @siva
siva: follow-ups: open infra ticket to add blobstore backpressure metrics and include in preflight checks. Also add note in release: v2.10.3 paused then mitigated for blobstore concurrency issue
jordan: thanks all. I'll update the release ticket and attach traces. Ready to continue ramp once hold expires
